page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Above the text: a woodcut ornament, then a large centred title block (roman capitals, then an italic subtitle). Below: a paragraph opened by a woodcut initial, with one marginal note on the right. No running head.

main_text.head: ANTIDOTVS CONTRA SCANDALVM, DATVM AB his, qui ab Ecclesiis Euangelicis ad Papatum deficiunt:

head.i: VNA CVM DEMONSTRATIONE errorum Papatus, & admonitione grauí ad Apostatas, vt resipiscant & ad Dominum redeuertantur.

main_text.p: INTER alia, quæ Spiritus Sanctus postremis temporibus euentura predixit, quæque euentu ipso comprobata sunt, Lector Christiane, non postremum est, quod priori ad Timotheum legimus: Spiritus, inquit Apostolus Paulus, 1.Tim.4. 1.{a}diserte dicit, fore vt posterioribus temporibus deficiant quidam à fide, Spiritibus deceptoribus animum attendentes, ac doctrinis dæmoniorum. Experientia enim, proh dolor, satis superque docet, nimium multos esse, qui his postremis calamitosissimis temporibus, ab Euangelica veritate, quam antea præ se ferebant deficientes, Iesuitis ac Capucinis, Spiritibus deceptoribus, & doctrinis dæmoniorum attendentes, Papatus errores amplectantur.

page.notes: The marginal reference on the right is printed as "1.Tim.4." with "1." on the line below; transcribed as one note. A small stray mark "I." sits beside it and was left out as not part of the reference. The signature "A ij" is slightly unclear and marked [?]. The initial I is a woodcut, joined to "NTER" as "INTER". The page ends mid-word ("hu-"), continued on the next page.
